summary:
Implemented KAFKA-20444 to align TxnOffsetCommit API with OffsetCommit API per KIP-1319. Changes include: (1) Modified KafkaProducer.sendOffsetsToTransaction to request metadata updates for untracked topics, enabling topic ID discovery before TxnOffsetCommit request is sent; (2) Refactored TransactionManager.TxnOffsetCommitHandler to defer request builder creation until send time, allowing topic IDs added by metadata refreshes to be incorporated; (3) Implemented lazy builder initialization in requestBuilder() method to check current metadata at send time rather than handler creation time, enabling TxnOffsetCommit v6 negotiation when topic IDs are available. This improves protocol alignment and efficiency as specified in KIP-1319.</parameter>
